meta.title: Counter offer dialog shows original vendor value next to the counter value

plan.title: Counter offer shows original and counter values

steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen for the RFQ event.
Configure the event with an RFQ pricing stage.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add one line item for the vendor bid.
Invite a vendor who will provide the QCS bid.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Create the known original vendor value of 100 in the RFQ QCS.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Open the RFQ QCS containing the vendor bid.

args.goal: On the RFQ Master QCS, click Counter Offer beneath the vendor's name, select the Price field, enter 90, and stop with the counter-offer dialog showing the original vendor value 100 and the entered counter offer value 90 side by side.

steps.note: Inspect the dialog state and verify both comparison values before sending the counter offer.
Assert that the counter-offer dialog remains open on screen.
